name: No Dark Corners
summary: Removes the dark shading in the corners of the screen, so the whole view stays evenly lit.
body:
**No Dark Corners** is a client-side resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition. It changes one specific thing about the vanilla look, and nothing else.

### What it changes
- The vignette overlay is replaced with a flat one, so no corner is darkened
- Nothing else is touched - the rest of the HUD stays vanilla

### Why players use it
- Easier to spot movement at the edges of your screen in a cave or at night
- The screen looks brighter without changing your brightness or gamma

### Install
1. Download the `.zip` file from this page (do not unzip it).
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks` - or use the CurseForge app.
3. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs** and move it to the top of the list.

Works on Minecraft **1.21.x** (Java Edition) and on most launchers. Client-side only: it works on any server, and no one else needs it.

---

### Get the whole set
This is part of the **PvP Essentials** family - the all-in-one pack with crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin: [PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low)
